text:
sam: quick flag  our streaming + pagination snippets are inconsistent across SDK pages — python shows resume_token but ts/go only show single-shot create(). we should align before docs cut.

anya: good catch. where's the python example?

sam: in PR 4782, short snippet: `resp = client.responses.create(..., stream=True, resume_token=rt); for ev in resp: if ev.type=='delta': print(ev.delta, end='')`

zheng: i can update TS to async-iterator + resumeToken. will also add a short note about when to resume vs resend prompt.

kai: i'll own Go. current Go List() example doesn't show Retry-After/backoff. i'll add cursor loop + simple exponential backoff and show honoring Retry-After header.

docs-ci: Checklist: 1) ts async iterator + resumeToken, 2) go cursor+retry example, 3) one-line resume guidance in streaming.md, 4) mocked smoke tests under /examples/smoke/ to run in docs CI. Add `ci: docs-smoke` label to PRs.

anya: timeline? docs cut is tomorrow morning.

zheng: i'll open TS PR in ~2h with smoke harness. snippet: `const s = await client.responses.stream({model:'rwd-4x', input:prompt, resumeToken:last}); for await (const e of s) { if (e.type==='delta') process.stdout.write(e.delta ?? ''); }`

kai: go draft: `cursor := ""; for { res, err := client.Responses.List(ctx, ListOpts{Cursor:cursor}); if err != nil { wait := backoff.Next(); time.Sleep(wait); continue }; for _,it := range res.Items { fmt.Println(it.Text) }; if res.NextCursor=="" { break }; cursor = res.NextCursor }` and check `Retry-After` header when err contains it.

anya: please keep param names idiomatic per language and add a tiny cross-ref between streaming.md and pagination.md.

docs-ci: automated check: ensure smoke harness is mocked to avoid network. will run on labeled PRs.

zheng: PR 4789 opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4789 (TS + smoke). linted and smoke mocked passed.

kai: PR 4790 opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4790 (Go cursor+retry). added Retry-After handling.

anya: i'll open small cross-ref PR and a one-line resume guidance tweak.

sam: thanks — once merged i'll update the release blurb: "Unify streaming & pagination code samples across SDKs; add resume/retry guidance."

docs-ci: PRs 4789/4790 pending final reviews. label `ci: docs-smoke` present.

zheng: merged 4789. smoke passed.

kai: merged 4790. added a small note about token TTL.

anya: cross-ref merged. closing thread 44D"
